#!/bin/bash

#flux: -A np01
# The PBS directive '-P np01' for project accounting is translated to the Flux directive '-A np01' or '--account=np01'.

#flux: --queue=normal
# Translates directly from PBS -q

#flux: --job-name="{{:name}}"
# Translates directly from PBS -N

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n {{:ncpus}}
#flux: --mem-per-node={{:mem}}G
# The PBS directive '-l ncpus={{:ncpus}}' requests a total number of CPU cores for the job.
# The PBS directive '-l mem={{:mem}}GB' requests a total amount of memory for the job.
# This is translated to a single-node Flux job (-N 1) with {{:ncpus}} tasks (-n) and the total memory assigned to that node (--mem-per-node={{:mem}}G).
# This is a common pattern, but if a multi-node job is intended, these directives would need to be adjusted.

#flux: -t {{:wallhr}}:00:00
# Translates directly from PBS -l walltime=...

#flux: --output="{{:name}}.out"
# The PBS directive '-j oe' merges standard output and error. This is the default behavior in Flux. 
# An output file name has been generated from the job name, as one was not specified in the original script.


source $HOME/hpc-environments/gadi/load-intel.sh
PROJECT_DIR=$SCRATCH/{{:dir_name}}/

# It is recommended to use 'flux run' instead of 'mpiexec' within a Flux job allocation for better integration with the scheduler.
flux run -n {{:ncpus}} julia --project=$PROJECT_DIR --check-bounds no -O3 \
    $PROJECT_DIR/scripts/Benchmarks/benchmark_gadi.jl \
    {{:name}} \
    {{{:write_dir}}} \
    {{:type}} \
    {{:bmark_type}} \
    {{:Nx_partition}} \
    {{:Ny_partition}} \
    {{:Nz_partition}} \
    {{:n_el_size}} \
    {{:fe_order}} \
    {{:verbose}} \
    {{:nreps}}

The value for the number of tasks (-n), '{{:ncpus}}', is a placeholder and not a valid integer.
The value for memory per node (--mem-per-node), '{{:mem}}G', is a placeholder and not a valid memory specification.
The value for walltime (-t), '{{:wallhr}}:00:00', is a placeholder and not a valid time format.
The value for the output file (--output), '{{:name}}.out', is based on a placeholder and is not a valid filename.
